body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2010') -- <Visual News> Audio Unlimited showcased its wireless rock speaker 'SPK-ROCK2' at CES 2010.

With this single add-on speaker users can create a multi-room sound system and have a freedom to listen to music just about anywhere in their house or yard without the hassle of running unsightly speaker wires.
